Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, s As String, r As Long, c As Long, v As Variant
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Range("A1:T20").Value = 1
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        ws.Rows("2:4").Group: v = TypeName(ws.Range("A1:C6").ApplyOutlineStyles)
        For r = 1 To 6: For c = 1 To 5: s = s & ws.Cells(r, c).Style.Name & ";": Next: s = s & "/": Next
    Case 1
        ws.Rows("2:4").Group: ws.Rows("3:3").Group: ws.Range("A1:C6").ApplyOutlineStyles
        For r = 1 To 6: For c = 1 To 5: s = s & ws.Cells(r, c).Style.Name & ";": Next: s = s & "/": Next
    Case 2
        ws.Columns("B:C").Group: ws.Range("A1:E6").ApplyOutlineStyles
        For r = 1 To 6: For c = 1 To 5: s = s & ws.Cells(r, c).Style.Name & ";": Next: s = s & "/": Next
    Case 3
        ws.Range("A1:C6").ApplyOutlineStyles
        For r = 1 To 6: For c = 1 To 5: s = s & ws.Cells(r, c).Style.Name & ";": Next: s = s & "/": Next
    Case 4
        ws.Rows("2:4").Group: ws.Outline.SummaryRow = xlAbove: ws.Range("A1:C6").ApplyOutlineStyles
        For r = 1 To 6: For c = 1 To 5: s = s & ws.Cells(r, c).Style.Name & ";": Next: s = s & "/": Next
    Case 5
        ws.Rows("2:4").Group: ws.Range("B5").ApplyOutlineStyles
        For r = 1 To 6: For c = 1 To 5: s = s & ws.Cells(r, c).Style.Name & ";": Next: s = s & "/": Next
    Case 6
        ws.Columns("B:C").Group: ws.Outline.SummaryColumn = xlLeft: ws.Range("A1:E6").ApplyOutlineStyles
        For r = 1 To 6: For c = 1 To 5: s = s & ws.Cells(r, c).Style.Name & ";": Next: s = s & "/": Next
    Case 7
        ws.Rows("2:14").Group: ws.Rows("3:13").Group: ws.Rows("4:12").Group: ws.Rows("5:11").Group: ws.Rows("6:10").Group: ws.Rows("7:9").Group: ws.Rows("8:8").Group: ws.Range("A1:A20").ApplyOutlineStyles
        For r = 1 To 20: s = s & ws.Cells(r, 1).Style.Name & ";": Next
    Case 8
        ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 2), ws.Cells(1, 14)).EntireColumn.Group: ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 3), ws.Cells(1, 13)).EntireColumn.Group: ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 4), ws.Cells(1, 12)).EntireColumn.Group: ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 5), ws.Cells(1, 11)).EntireColumn.Group: ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 6), ws.Cells(1, 10)).EntireColumn.Group: ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 7), ws.Cells(1, 9)).EntireColumn.Group: ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 8), ws.Cells(1, 8)).EntireColumn.Group: ws.Range("A1:T1").ApplyOutlineStyles
        For c = 1 To 20: s = s & ws.Cells(1, c).Style.Name & ";": Next
    End Select
    Tried = "ok " & v & "|" & s
Saved:
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Saved
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 8
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
